title: MORITURI, a 3D multiplayer gladiator brawler for your browser, built almost entirely with Claude Code + Codex
author: Ylboomhs
selftext:
I made the game my friends and I have been itching to play. **MORITURI** is a 3D gladiator brawler you play right in your browser: pick one of five gladiators and knock your friends out of the arena, 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or free-for-all, while trapdoors, a volcano, a ramming warship and lions try to do it for you.

The stack is three.js in the browser, with the multiplayer hosted on Cloudflare (Workers and Durable Objects run the match rooms). Claude Code does most of the building, and Codex does second-opinion code reviews and the grunt work. Every model, song and sound effect is generated in code.

It's free and in closed alpha, and I'm letting people in in waves. It is fully playable in the current state, but really focusing on polishing and edge-cases. I would love for you to try it out. Sign up here: [**https://morituri.gg**](https://morituri.gg/)

replies.author: Ylboomhs
replies.body: Thanks man much appreciated - definitely a labor of love

replies.author: Ylboomhs
replies.body: Thanks! If you apply on the site I can get more in to continue stress testing the multiplayer experience before going full open beta.
